headline: Karachi Fintech Neem Secures ADB Ventures Investment in Pre-Series A Round
summary: Embedded finance platform Neem secured an undisclosed investment from ADB Ventures, completing about 80% of its Pre-Series A funding round to expand financial infrastructure in Pakistan.
why: Venture capital backing from multilateral institutions highlights institutional interest in South Asian financial technology platforms.

impacts.name: Neem
impacts.why: ADB Ventures investment provides equity capital to expand financial infrastructure in Pakistan.
